note: The most consequential ICP row in the batch, because it tests the stated definition against its own example. The ICP quote says the prospects Primal deals with 'own their own business, or they're a physician, something along those lines' — and this is the corpus's first actual physician: private practice, hospital post, newly appointed professor of medicine, married to another doctor. Matches successful without qualification. Matches good_to_great as purely as anyone in the corpus: 'I got to a pretty decent strength level, an intermediate level for a calisthenic athlete, but I was neglecting a lot of stuff in terms of endurance, in terms of VO2 max... I'm not really satisfied with that', with a body-fat target of 10-12% from 13-14%. Matches not_deconditioned emphatically — eight to twelve clean pull-ups with 20 kg added, dips with 25 kg, training four to six sessions a week. Misses neglected_health outright and in the same benign direction as the Andy and Jared Lyons assessments: health is the most tended area of this man's life, not the neglected one, which means the criterion is excluding people who are fitter than the definition contemplates. Misses income, and this is the finding. He makes good money as a physician in Brazil, and the ICP's test for this criterion is affordability, which he failed — $6,000 converts to roughly R$25,000-28,000 and even the reduced $4,000 tier to about R$20,000, against a household mid-renovation with a second child due in October and a temporary income dip. He validated the price rather than disputing it: 'I don't think it's an absurd value... for Trevor's work and for the accountability, I think actually that is pretty fair.' So the ICP named his profession, he met the profile on every non-financial criterion, and he was excluded by an exchange rate. That is the same shape as the observation already recorded against the Badrane Hriouch assessment — 'makes good money' doing work a payment plan should be doing — with geography added: 'makes good money' is not a property of an occupation, it is a property of an occupation in a currency, and the stated ICP has no currency or region dimension at all. Edge rather than outside because three of five criteria match and the two misses both point at the definition rather than at the prospect. Judged on criteria, not outcome.
